Typing Playbook

01Accuracy Before Speed

Every Mistake Costs Time And Breaks Streak. Hold 95% Accuracy First, Then Raise Pace By 5 WPM Steps.

02Anchor On Home Row

Rest Fingers On A S D F And J K L Semicolon. Feel The F And J Bumps To Reset Without Looking Down.

03Fifteen Focused Minutes

Short Daily Sessions Beat Weekend Marathons. Try One 60 Second Endurance Run Every Day.

04Eyes On Screen

Never Watch The Keyboard. Trust Muscle Memory And Let The Next-Key Radar Guide Your Fingers.

05Drill Weak Keys

Paste Tricky Words Or Symbols Into Custom Mode And Repeat Until They Feel Automatic.

06Stay Loose

Relaxed Wrists Type Faster. Shake Out Tension Between Runs And Keep A Steady Rhythm.
